summary: Executed backend pytest API suite and frontend Playwright flows against external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Backend critical flows passed; frontend core flow works but copy action crashes result page and history behavior/testability is inconsistent. MOCKED integrations confirmed in result warnings.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking Copy triggers uncaught runtime error overlay: Clipboard write permission denied (NotAllowedError), breaking page flow.
Dynamic row/view/delete data-testid selectors are not present in rendered DOM during testing, blocking reliable automation and indicating testability regression.

integration_issues.issue: History UI intermittently rendered empty in some runs while direct /api/v1/sessions call in browser context returned populated data; indicates frontend state/render mismatch or environment inconsistency.

action_items: Wrap ResultPage copy() clipboard call in try/catch and show toast instead of crashing when Clipboard API permission is denied.
Verify deployed HistoryPage markup contains required data-testid attributes for row/view/delete controls as implemented in source.
Investigate history empty-state mismatch vs populated /api/v1/sessions response (frontend state update/render consistency and deployment parity).
Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md with active test credentials for future agents; file currently contains template only.
critical_code_review_comments: ResultPage copy() lacks error handling for navigator.clipboard.writeText and can throw uncaught exceptions in non-permitted contexts.
HistoryPage remove() has no try/catch; failed delete requests would currently fail silently at UI level except implicit errors.
Observed source-vs-runtime divergence in data-testid availability on History row controls; verify build/deployment consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite passed end-to-end including create/upload/process/poll/result/update/delete and validation errors. UI core flow (landing/login/record/process/result) works and MOCKED warning banner appears. Copy button crash is reproducible. History page shows rows visually but dynamic history data-testid selectors were absent in runtime DOM; use fallback selectors if needed while this is fixed.
rca of the issue: Copy crash RCA: ResultPage copy handler calls navigator.clipboard.writeText without try/catch. In automation/non-secure permission contexts, this throws NotAllowedError, propagates uncaught runtime error, and React overlay interrupts remaining interactions. History inconsistency RCA hypothesis: runtime build appears divergent from source for dynamic data-testid attributes and list rendering behavior, causing flaky/empty UI despite successful API responses. MOCKED APIs in use: Sarvam speech-to-text, Sarvam translation, Gemini prescription extraction.
